text:
luis-support: Heads-up — customer Nexeo reported they lost access to billing and model inference right after the KMS policy rollout this morning (us-west-2).

deploy-bot: policy-rollout completed for kms-key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345 at 2026-03-10T08:42:17Z :white_check_mark:

maya-sec: on it. can you paste the error the customer sees?

luis-support: pasted from support logs: 
```
Error: permission denied
caused_by: KMS:AccessDeniedException: User arn:aws:sts::444455556666:assumed-role/redwood-api/redwood-svc is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345
context: tenant_id=nexeo, request_id=8f3a2e
```

aj-platform: quick glance — the KMS key policy rollout removed the service principal binding for redwood-priv-service. Also seeing rolesync job failure in logs around 08:45:
```
rolesync: tenant=nexeo status=failed reason="upstream 502" attempts=1
```

tara-support: Customer says they also can't open Billing -> Invoices and can't start new model runs. They're blocked for production usage right now. Escalating to SRE and eng-security.

ben-runtime: for immediate workaround we can grant model access via the admin backend (bypass KMS path) — will need a manual call. Command: 
```
rbacctl grant --tenant nexeo --role model.runner --actor admin-service --reason "emergency temporary uplift"
```

maya-sec: don't do that at scale. we need to verify if keys were rotated incorrectly or if policy generation truncated service accounts. aj, can you fetch the key policy diff?

aj-platform: pulling diff now. snippet: 
```
-    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-priv-service"},
+    "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/redwood-priv-service:REDACTED"},
```
looks like templating bug removed exact role ARN for multi-tenant keys. Rolesync then failed when trying to decrypt tenant metadata.

sre-oncall: starting rollback of policy rollout for that key and re-running rolesync for nexeo. ETA ~7m. tagging ops-run: OR-2026-137.

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345 by sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: rollback complete at 2026-03-10T08:51:12Z. re-running rolesync for tenant=nexeo now.

maya-sec: once rolesync finishes, check RBAC bindings: billing.viewer and model.runner should be present. Also verify KV cache and token encryption paths.

ben-runtime: rolesync finished, logs show tenant=nexeo bindings re-applied. Running quick smoke test against inference endpoint now.

olivia-cs: Nexeo confirms they can view invoices and their model runs are back. They reported ~3 failed calls prior but now successful.

luis-support: marking ticket as resolved for customer. will follow up with credits and incident summary. Ticket ID: SUP-2026-2319.

maya-sec: creating incident INC-2026-1082 for postmortem. Root cause: templating bug in kms policy generator that mangled service principal ARN for multi-tenant keys; secondary impact: rolesync failed on decrypt, leading to temporary RBAC gaps. Action items: 
- add pre-rollout KMS policy validation (check for exact ARN match)
- add 2-step canary for tenants with billing access (do not roll keys for tenants in production buckets until canary passes)
- make rolesync resilient to transient KMS errors (retry/backoff + circuit breaker for per-tenant)
- add alert when tenant rolesync skips >0 tenants during rollout

aj-platform: filing PR for validation hooks and a fix to templating in the generator.

tara-support: confirming customer follow-up scheduled for EOD PST.

luis-support: thank you everyone. awarding Nexeo 3 days of service credit and noting follow-up in the ticket.

maya-sec: postmortem draft will include timeline and the recovery commands we used. assigning owners: aj-platform (generator fix), ben-runtime (rolesync hardening), maya-sec (policy validations).

luis-support: closing thread — will attach postmortem link once available. :white_check_mark:
